scope: Full current relocation retention planning, revalidation and source disposition tests
assessment: Only expired registered objects with verified independent copies eligible; configured sources, evidence, missing/corrupt copies, hardlinks and pending migrations protected
Changed source/recovery inode, bytes, configuration references, new runs or root aliases invalidate plan
Quarantine and restore have verified inventory disposition; foreign notes, corrupt retained media and edited receipt remain visible
Interrupted quarantine receipt exposes COMMIT_STARTED and allows completion; already quarantined sources excluded from second cleanup
Actual CLI and Studio HTTP inventory observations agree; reverse backup quarantine and restore verified

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=tests:plugins/app-store-creative/scripts python3 -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_relocation_retention_plan test_relocation_retention_verification test_relocation_source_dispositions -q

limitations: No permanent purge performed; planning and quarantine do not imply purge approval
Read-only retention verification compares path list rather than all bytes; broader no-write proof separate
Disposable single-filesystem fixtures and injected receipt interruption; real product, browser and cross-volume acceptance remain open
